# Waitloop

> Developer-native waiting layer for coding agents. Hooks report minimal lifecycle state; games fill short waits; work immediately takes priority again when the agent needs attention.

Canonical agent integration guide: https://waitloop.run/agent.md
Machine-readable manifest: https://waitloop.run/agent.json
Waitloop skill: https://waitloop.run/skills/waitloop/SKILL.md
Game MCP endpoint: https://waitloop.run/mcp
Health: https://waitloop.run/api/v1/health
Source: https://github.com/shixushi2025/waitloop

Important integration rule: lifecycle hooks and game MCP are separate. Hooks report running/waiting/completed/failed. MCP controls one authorized game seat and requires a room-specific seat token.
